entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Once we pass through here, we won't[n]have any choice but to confront Maruki.
entries.uk: Щойно пройдемо тут, нам нічого[n]не лишиться, як протистояти Марукі.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You ready, Joker?
Absolutely.
Not quite yet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right. Let's do it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right. We should be careful about this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's another small theater...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But it feels different, somehow.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Looks like this is the last small theater.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Above this is the observation deck.

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: We're almost there.

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: Oracle, how do we get to[n]the observation deck?
entries.uk: Оракуле, як нам дістатися[n]до оглядового майданчика?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think there's an elevator[n]in the back of the theater.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It looks like you're gonna need[n]tickets again.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Another theater probably means[n]we have to view his past again.
entries.uk: Ще один кінозал — мабуть, знову[n]доведеться дивитися його минуле.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't know if he's looking for sympathy[n]or not, but I say it's too late.
entries.uk: Не знаю, чи шукає він співчуття,[n]але, як на мене, вже запізно.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let's find the tickets fast[n]and get this over with.
entries.uk: Знайдімо квитки швидше[n]й покінчімо з цим.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? The elevator went down.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But we just rode it up here.
entries.uk: Але ж ми щойно на ньому піднялися.

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: That's strange. Should we call it again?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, let's do that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, that explains that.

entries.speaker: Researcher Shadow
entries.en: How did you make it this far!?[n]No matter! You won't get out alive!
entries.uk: Як ви сюди дісталися!?[n]Байдуже! Живими вам не вийти!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, COME ON!

entries.speaker: Researcher Shadow
entries.en: I will make you a member of Eden!
